title: Products
intro: Practical resources that help you choose a business problem, take action, and build momentum.

offers.title: Free Agentic Readiness Assessment
offers.short: Find out whether one recurring workflow is ready for AI that can coordinate work across people and systems.
expanded: Answer ten focused questions about your business, a recurring workflow, the information it needs, and the decisions people must retain. Your free report identifies readiness gaps, a possible first opportunity, and practical next steps.

Start with the business outcome: more capacity, fewer delays, stronger margins, or less dependence on the owner. Recommendations may include improving the process, connecting existing tools, or testing a bounded agentic workflow. A deeper assessment validates feasibility before implementation.
offers.best: Owners and operations leaders of established service businesses whose growth is creating more coordination and administrative work.
value: A qualitative readiness assessment, priorities to validate, and a practical 30–60–90-day plan.

The employee leaves with techniques they can apply in their role and a clearer understanding of when human judgment is needed.
offers.best: Employees who need individual practice tied to their role and quality standards.

offers.title: Business Context Integration and Prompt Systems: Turn What Your Business Knows Into Better Results
offers.short: Connect existing information with practical AI systems and tested prompts to reduce research, repeated explanations, and rework.
expanded: Your business already holds valuable context in documents, meeting notes, customer records, procedures, and everyday decisions. We identify the sources that matter to a selected workflow, organize the relevant information, and integrate it into a practical system your team can use.

We build reusable prompts and instructions around your standards, customers, and goals, then test them against real tasks such as preparing proposals, responding to clients, onboarding employees, or producing reports.
Within the agreed scope, you receive a source and context map, a working context-supported workflow, a tested prompt library, and guidance for reviewing outputs and keeping information current.
The focus is making your existing knowledge useful at the moment work happens, with clear ownership of updates and appropriate access to source material.
offers.best: Businesses whose teams repeatedly search for information, explain the same context to AI, or correct generic outputs.
value: Time spent finding and preparing information, task completion time, output quality, review effort, rework, and adoption of the shared system.

offers.short: A promising workflow needs practical evidence before a larger commitment.

offers.title: AI Business Brains and Marketplace Knowledge Products: Put Your Expertise to Work Inside Your Business and Beyond
offers.short: Build a reusable AI brain that helps your team apply company knowledge, or package your expertise into a knowledge product designed for marketplace sales.
expanded: Your experience, methods, and business knowledge can become an asset people use repeatedly. Building on our work with Mygentic, we help turn approved source material into a focused AI brain with a clear audience, useful capabilities, and a practical plan for testing and ongoing improvement.
Internal Business Brain
Give employees a consistent way to find and apply your processes, service standards, product knowledge, training, and lessons learned.

We organize the knowledge around real questions and tasks, define how the brain should respond, and test its usefulness with the people who will use it. The aim is faster onboarding, fewer repeated questions, more consistent work, and less dependence on one person holding all the answers.
Marketplace Knowledge Product
Turn expertise you own or are authorized to commercialize into a focused brain for a defined buyer and business problem.
We help shape the offer, organize the knowledge, develop useful prompts and guided experiences, test representative tasks, and prepare product descriptions, demonstrations, and onboarding materials.

Marketplace preparation includes planning access, support, and updates. Publication follows the selected platform’s requirements and your approval. Private company and client information stays separate from the material intended for sale.

Within the agreed scope, the work includes an audience and use-case brief, a knowledge map, a working brain prototype, testing criteria, and an ownership and update plan. The internal path focuses on business adoption. The marketplace path also considers buyer demand, delivery costs, and the effort required to support customers.
offers.best: Businesses that want to preserve and share institutional knowledge, and experts or firms that want to turn authorized expertise into a repeatable product.
value: For internal use: time to find answers, onboarding effort, answer quality, adoption, and expert time recovered.
For marketplace products: validated buyer interest, activation, repeat use, sales conversion, revenue, support costs, and contribution margin.
